why: Each figure adds one new item on top of the column: arrow, then square, then cross. So the next figure needs a circle on top of cross and square, and it still has the arrow: 4 items in all. Options 3 and 4 have all four items, but only option 3 keeps them stacked circle-cross-square from top to bottom. Option 2 has lost the arrow.
trick: In 'add one item' series, count the items: the answer has exactly one more.
note: In option C the arrow sits beside the square instead of under it; still the best fit and the book answer.
